notes.title: Walkthrough fixes
notes.notes: As it turned out, a faster way of passing the game was found than it was originally intended. Fixed this, as well as a few other comments.

notes.title: New languages
notes.notes: New languages: German, Polish and French.

notes.title: Find a converter!
notes.notes: Dizzy went down to the witch, but cannot find the converter again! Help him!

notes.title: Aggravation game
notes.notes: The wicked witch allowed to enter the basement, but the objects were scattered! Can you complete the game?

notes.title: Big update 1.0
notes.notes:
Big update:

- Changed the plot,
- Added achievements,
- Added sounds,
- Added messages about the impossibility to take the 4rd item,
- Added language saving.

Bugfixes:
- Saving the state of the diving mask,
- Accidental overwrite of the first save,
- Fixed possible stuck hero in locations "house" and "houses in trees".
